title: Validate the latest bounded UI direction
ui_direction: Bounded polish of the existing TDTB cockpit UI (SetupDrawer, CalendarImpact, ApprovalDrawer). No redesign; current components and the calm DATA visual language (tokens.css) are preserved.

observations.name: Intention clarity and one-focus helper
observations.treatment: SetupDrawer Captures > Intention field gains a one-focus helper and ARIA wiring. Helper text is the exact, declarative sentence 'One thing to focus on today.' so the primary daily capture reads as a single focus, not a free journal.

measurable.text_equals: One thing to focus on today.

tests: feedback13.test.tsx > obs 1+2: getByText('One thing to focus on today.') and aria-describedby

observations.name: Readable intention textarea states
observations.treatment: The intention textarea gets a distinct, explicitly-defined treatment (.field textarea.cap-intention) so it reads clearly against the muted default fields. Each required state is named in CSS: readable text, surface, border, focus, and spacing.

measurable.focus: :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--t-accent); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--t-accent) }

tests: feedback13.test.tsx > obs 1+2: className contains cap-intention + 5 CSS-source assertions for color/background/border/focus/min-height

observations.name: Calendar hierarchy (desktop + narrow, no overlap)
observations.treatment: CalendarImpact row is a documented grid hierarchy: time, event, class badge, duration, count, reason, actions. The flexible event column carries min-width:0 so it truncates instead of pushing the row past the viewport. At <=767px the row re-templates to one fixed time column + a flexible column, and the attend control spans full width — no horizontal overlap at either width.
tests: feedback13.test.tsx > obs 3: time/event/class/count/reason/actions render; .calendar-impact__row present; event min-width:0 in CSS; @media 767px rule present

observations.name: Results/Preview hierarchy (desktop + narrow, no overlap)
observations.treatment: ApprovalDrawer keeps a desktop baseline: .surface-totals auto-fit grid (>=120px) and .write-row flex (name flex:1, target max-width:46%). At <=520px the write-row wraps and the name + target each take a full line so neither clips the other; surface totals drop to two columns. The collapsed-by-default Exact-writes disclosure and the two-gate arm->commit flow are untouched.

measurable.narrow_media: @media (max-width: 520px) { .write-row { flex-wrap: wrap } ; .write-row__name { flex-basis: 100% } ; .write-row__path { flex-basis: 100%; max-width: 100% } ; .surface-totals { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr } }

tests: feedback13.test.tsx > obs 4: surface-totals + write-row (after disclosure) render; verified case shows 'All surfaces verified — zero failures'; @media 520px rule present

observations.name: Strict 12-hour user-facing time examples
observations.treatment: Every user-facing time is rendered through display12h (AM/PM). Native <input type=time> is locale-adaptive and is not a hardcoded 24-hour example; no bare HH:MM example string is presented to the user. No 24-hour display requirement is introduced.

measurable.no_bare_24h: no visible text matches /\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?!\s*(AM|PM))/ (native input values are not textContent)

tests: feedback13.test.tsx > obs 5: text matches /AM|PM/ and bare 24h regex is null; calendar-capacity.test.tsx already asserts 12-hour wall-clock (FEEDBACK-12)

gates_preserved.hard_wall: CalendarImpact renders 'hard block' affordance on fixed/work rows only (.calendar-impact__wall). Unchanged.
gates_preserved.quarantine: Quarantined rows render excluded / 'Not counted' / 0 blocks, never Fixed. FEEDBACK-04 test unchanged.
gates_preserved.zero_writer: Calendar rows are projection-only via saveAnchoredOverride (local override); never event or source mutation. Unchanged.
gates_preserved.local_projection: Seeded duration adjustments render a 'projection' marker and keep the event window untouched. Unchanged.
gates_preserved.commit_gate: ApprovalDrawer two-gate flow (arm live -> second click commit), canLiveCommit / shadowBlockers gating. Unchanged.

constraints_respected: Preserved FEEDBACK-23..29 behavior (no component/timeline changes to those paths).
No live writes, external source mutations, restart, or commit (test-only, FixtureAdapter).
